title: Solomon gathers forces and plans the temple construction
description: After returning to Jerusalem, Solomon strengthens the kingdom by assembling a large army with fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. Silver and gold become as common as stone in Jerusalem, and he establishes trade for horses and chariots from Egypt and Kue, which are then resold to Hittite and Aramean kings. The chapter concludes with his decision to build a house for the name of the Lord and a house for his kingdom.
